blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A fire that destroyed 13 houses and displaced 19 families in Catbalogan City, Samar along with a smaller cemetery fire in Tanauan and a structurally damaged mausoleum in Jaro, both in Leyte, were among the incidents reported in Eastern Visayas during the observance of Undas. In Catbalogan City, a fire hit Barangay Canlapwas at 12:30 p.m. on Sunday, Nov. 1, destroying 13 houses and damaging another before it was declared out at 1:50 p.m. An initial Rapid Damage Assessment and Needs Analysis conducted by the City Engineering Office and the City Social Welfare and Development Office, in coordination […]...
